newsitem.title: USA: Dow rises more than 50 points in morning trade.
newsitem.headline: Dow rises more than 50 points in morning trade.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average rose more than 50 points Thursday following strong gains in the bond market.

At 10:30 a.m. EDT, the index of 30 blue chip issues was up 51.52 points at 7,627.35, which activated the New York Stock Exchange's limits on program trading. The benchmark 30-year Treasury bond was up 27/32, or $8.44 per $1,000 of face value, sending its yield down to 6.77 percent from 6.84 percent on Wednesday.
